cluster: C14 Suffering, doubt, failure, hypocrisy, leaving
method: coverage_search.py --whole-words per sub-question (runs S1-S9 under search/C14/), hits read in context against retrieve_when and use_note.means; records layer judged by hand; LOADED from cic/corpus-map files; IDENTIFIED from records/<code>/source kind: unvendored, Doc_02, WANTS-REGISTER, download-queue-seed; quotes verified verbatim with verify_quotes.py and diverge.py

layers.RENDERED: a record in records/<code>/ answers (kind: answer | absence = answered as honest_limit/contested | thin)
layers.LOADED: no record answers; a vendored text mapped to the world does
layers.IDENTIFIED: named in a source registry, not vendored
layers.OTHER: public-domain or open source outside the repo

excluded.fix: synthetic fixture world; aec, hus, jes, meth, obel, rcg, wsyr have no records
